newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-NYMEX eyes coal futures contract in 1997.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-NYMEX eyes coal futures contract in 1997.

text.p: NYMEX/COMEX said on Monday it hopes to launch a coal futures contract next year.
The New York-based exchange is in the process of putting together a coal advisory committee, John Moore, chairman of the Comex Governors Committee of NYMEX/COMEX told Reuters.
"That is usually the next step," Moore said after addressing the Asia-Pacific Commodity Markets conference here.
Moore said there were indications of interest in a coal futures contract, particularly among coal-fired power generating companies.
However, it will be a key task of the advisory committee to formulate an industry consensus on how a contract would be structured, he said.
"But it is just like the aluminium contract, the interest is there but you talk to 10 different people you get 10 different ideas on how it should be done.
The exchange also is eyeing establishing a futures markets in aluminium, Moore said.
Also under consideration are so-called region-specific futures contracts that would be traded on NYMEX/COMEX's after-hours ACCESS trading system and cash-settled, Moore said.
If that occurred, it would represent a departure for the exchange, since all its current commodities markets provide for physical delivery, he added.
